weekly_closures: The Karnataka government notification also lists all Sundays, second Saturdays and fourth Saturdays as government-office holidays. This does not independently confirm the college closure schedule.
restricted_holidays_note: Restricted holidays are a separate category for eligible government employees and are not treated here as universal college holidays.
year_2027: Not added: the Karnataka Government 2027 holiday notification was not available in the sources checked as of 15 November 2026.
source_note: Based on Government of Karnataka Notification No. DPAR 16 HHL 2025 dated 17 November 2025. College-specific holiday closure must be confirmed with Canara Engineering College.
